Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You’ll join our Talent team and help build the team that builds a bank. We’re scaling fast across Berlin, New York and Dallas, and every hire either raises or lowers the bar. You’ll own real parts of our hiring engine from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.

  • What you’ll work on:

    • Source and engage candidates across engineering, product, operations, compliance and sales.

    • Coordinate interview processes and keep hiring managers and candidates moving.

    • Build and automate our recruiting workflows with Ashby, n8n and AI, so we hire better without adding headcount.

    • Own a larger project, like a new sourcing channel, our employer brand, or hiring analytics.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You are relentless about finding great people. You’d rather send 50 personalized messages than post and pray.

  • You know every candidate interaction reflects on Augustus, and you treat it that way.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

  • You can build workflows in n8n/zapier/make.

  • You are comfortable talking to senior leaders, hiring managers, and candidates from day one.

  • You are genuinely excited about what we are building.

This is not for you if:

  • You only want to work on strategic projects.

  • You see recruiting as admin work.

  • You need to know exactly what you will be working on before you join.

  • You are looking for a 9-5 role.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, or consulting and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations, research, or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • You are available for 3-6 months.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Responsibilities

1. Business Partnership & Decision Support
  • Serve as the core BI Partner for the Payment business; develop deep understanding of business scenarios including Crypto Pay, stablecoin payments, merchant payments, and cross-border payments — covering business models, core metrics, and growth drivers.
  • Independently collaborate with business leaders, Product, Operations, and BD teams to understand business objectives and real challenges; proactively identify business issues, growth opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Build analytical frameworks from a business perspective; deliver in-depth insights and actionable recommendations through data analysis to support product strategy, business planning, and key decision-making.
  • Go beyond passively fulfilling data requests — actively participate in business discussions and drive data analysis to genuinely influence business decisions.
2. Payment Analytics & Deep-Dive Analysis
  • Own in-depth analysis across Payment-related businesses, covering Crypto Pay, Stablecoin Payments, Merchant Payments, Cross-border Payments, and more.
  • Build systematic analysis and monitoring frameworks around core metrics including transaction volume, payment success rate, conversion rate, active users, merchant activity, transaction frequency, and revenue.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses across dimensions such as users, merchants, products, payment methods, PSPs, payment channels, and regional markets to identify key factors affecting business performance.
  • Independently perform root cause analysis, attribution analysis, and trend analysis for metric anomalies or performance fluctuations; provide thorough explanations of the business reasons behind data changes.
  • Identify potential business opportunities by incorporating industry trends, competitor performance, and market shifts; provide analytical support for Payment product development and market expansion.
3. Business Growth & Performance Optimization
  • Use data analysis to support Payment product growth, user acquisition and retention, payment penetration improvement, merchant growth, and transaction volume expansion.
  • Analyze user payment behavior, transaction conversion funnels, merchant performance, and payment channel efficiency to uncover growth bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.
  • Evaluate the business impact of product features, marketing campaigns, PSP partnerships, and payment channel strategies; provide recommendations for product iteration, channel optimization, and resource allocation.
  • Collaborate with business, product, and operations teams to translate analytical recommendations into concrete actions; continuously track and measure business improvement outcomes.
  • Support business evaluation and growth strategy development for new products, new markets, and new payment scenarios through data analysis.
4. Analytical Ownership & Business Impact
  • Independently own complex end-to-end analytical projects, including problem definition, analytical framework design, hands-on data analysis, strategic recommendations, execution driving, and impact evaluation.
  • Build and continuously optimize the Payment business KPI framework, dashboards, analytical models, and monitoring mechanisms to improve analysis efficiency and quality.
  • Go beyond routine reporting — proactively challenge existing assumptions, dig deep into root causes, and propose actionable solutions.
  • Take ownership of delivery quality and business outcomes for key analytical projects; drive measurable business impact from analytical outputs.
  • Develop reusable analytical frameworks, methodologies, and data assets to enhance the team's analytical capabilities and business support efficiency.


Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in BI, Business Analytics, Product Analytics, or related data analysis roles; prior experience in Payment, Fintech, PSP, or Digital Wallet industries is a strong plus.
  • Payment Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of payment business models, transaction flows, merchant payment scenarios, payment channels, and core business metrics; deep knowledge of the payment industry ecosystem and business growth logic.
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL (Hive/ODPS) and Python; capable of independently handling complex data analysis, data processing, and analytical model development; familiar with Tableau, Power BI, DeepInsight, or other BI tools.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong structured thinking and complex problem-solving abilities; capable of independently conducting deep-dive analysis, root cause analysis, attribution analysis, and business impact evaluation.
  • Business Acumen: Strong business sensitivity; able to deeply understand business goals and core drivers, proactively identify problems and opportunities, and translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Ownership: Highly proactive and independently accountable; able to independently own a business domain, lead complex analytical projects, and drive cross-functional collaboration and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills and cross-team influence; capable of independently partnering with business leaders, Product, Operations, and other teams to drive data-driven business decisions.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-changing business environment; stays attuned to emerging payment products, market trends, and new business opportunities

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in BI, Product Analytics, or Business Analytics at established payment platforms or PSPs.
  • Hands-on project experience in Payment Growth, Merchant Analytics, Payment Conversion Optimization, or PSP Performance Analysis.
  • Familiarity with business scenarios including Crypto Pay, Stablecoin Payments, Digital Wallet, Cross-border Payments, and Merchant Acquiring.
  • Experience building business metric frameworks and analytical structures from scratch (0 to 1), or supporting new payment product launches and business growth initiatives.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving product optimization, payment conversion rate improvement, transaction volume growth, merchant growth, or revenue growth through data analysis.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

Every person and every business connected to the Global Financial Internet. Built on Mural.

That's the world Mural is building. This role is one of the hands on the brush.

About Mural

Mural is regulated financial infrastructure across the US and Latin America. The whole stack, one partner. Companies build cross-border financial products on us using our API. We carry the licenses, the compliance, and the failure states, so they go live in weeks instead of months. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there.

We've processed over $2 billion across US dollar, stablecoin, and international rails. That includes USDC and USDT on major blockchains, ACH and wire in the US, and local rails across Latin America and Europe (PIX, SPEI, Bre-B, CBU/CVU, SEPA). Customers include Deel, Bolt, Opera, Koywe, Taxdome, Uniswap, Movii, and more. Forward-deployed engineers deploy with your team until you're live, and Mural's agentic teammate stays after. We've successfully raised our Series A. And we're an AI-native company. Agentic tools are how we build, operate, and scale.

The Role

Everything Mural ships is technical: licenses, custody models, real-time rails, KYB and KYC, Know Your Agent, an MCP server, a checkout that clears purchases for humans and agents. Everywhere Mural shows up, it has to be plain: the website, social, email, the product, the docs, the sales deck, and Mural's agentic teammate, who speaks for us to every customer every day. The gap between those two sentences is this job.

You will own how Mural's products are explained, everywhere they are explained. You report to the CEO and work directly with the CTO, the engineers shipping the product, and the brand team. You will hold the voice, the vocabulary, and the truth gate: nothing we say is ahead of what is live.

The bigger picture is the one you will be writing into existence. Money is becoming software, and the next generation of commerce will be transacted by agents acting for people and businesses. Someone has to be the compliant system of record those agents connect to, with a verified identity, a permission, and an audit trail on every action. That is Mural's bet, and it needs a narrator who can make it concrete: not "agentic payments" as a slogan, but what an agent's account looks like, what clears a purchase, and why a CPO at a fintech should build on it this quarter.

What You'll Do

  • Own the copy for every surface: website, product, docs, email, social, decks, and launch posts. Write most of it yourself.

  • Turn every shipped feature into a story, in one sentence and in one page, the day it ships. The changelog entry, the LinkedIn post, the email, and the sales one-liner come from you.

  • Write the voice of Mural's agentic teammate. It is a forward-deployed teammate, not a chatbot. How it explains a failed payment, an RFI, or a new product is product marketing, and it is yours.

  • Hold the voice and vocabulary across the company: what we say, what we never say, and how "infrastructure" travels into Spanish.

  • Run the truth gate with Compliance. Every external claim passes legal review, and you make that fast instead of slow.

  • Build the narrative for the agentic future with the founders and carry it into everything from the Product page to investor updates.

  • Ship in Spanish as well as English, with the team in Latin America.

Who You Are

  • 3 to 5 years in product marketing, at least part of it at a startup where you were the whole function.

  • A writer first. Your samples are copy people actually read: landing pages, launch posts, docs, emails. Short sentences, real nouns, no adjectives doing a number's job.

  • You can read an API reference and explain it to a CFO without losing what is true.

  • You're AI-native. Agentic tools are how you already draft, research, and ship, and we will ask you to show us.

  • Big plus: you speak Spanish natively. Most of our customers and their customers are in Latin America, and the site, the product, and our agentic teammate will all speak Spanish. If you can write it as well as you write English, you are ahead of every other candidate.

  • Strong pluses: fintech or infrastructure marketing, developer marketing, and a point of view on where agentic commerce is going.

What Success Looks Like

  • A CPO reads one page of the site and can say what Mural does and why it is different, in their own words.

  • Every launch ships with its story on the same day, on every surface, in one voice.

  • Mural's agentic teammate sounds like Mural everywhere it speaks.

  • Compliance clears copy in hours, not weeks, because you wrote it to pass the first time.

How We Work

We run on three principles.

2% better, every day. One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you.

Telos. From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos.

Build. We build AI-natively and we build to win. AI is a teammate. Do something manual once, then automate it. Speed and parallel execution are structural advantages, and we use them.

We're builders all the way down. Code is a medium, like paint. We choose honesty over polish and never claim what isn't true. We obsess over boring details, because trust is built in RFIs, refunds, and response times. And we hire for curiosity. It's a bar, not a poster.

The Process

  1. Intro screen

  2. Writing exercise: a real feature brief shared 24 hours ahead. You come back with a page, a post, and the agentic teammate's version of it.

  3. Onsite: a product decomposition session with our CTO, a narrative session with our CEO, and a culture conversation with the Growth team.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive cash base salary

  • Meaningful early-stage equity

  • Health insurance

  • 401(k)

  • Visa sponsorship available

Location

New York City, in person.

We named this company Mural because murals have always told the story of a community. They are made by hand, made together, painted onto the foundations of a place, and meant to outlast the people who started them. Every person who joins brings a new piece.

Now let's build a force of nature business, together.
